purpose: Harmonize hypothesis-like propositions across mathematical, empirical, computational, statistical and symbolic domains without conflating proof, execution, evidence or novelty.
invariants: IDEA != FORMULA != HYPOTHESIS != IMPLEMENTATION != EXECUTION != EVIDENCE != CLAIM != ACADEMIC_NOVELTY
M0-M4 applies to mathematical novelty only
a rejected or disfavored hypothesis remains in history
symbolic or spiritual interpretations are not empirical hypotheses unless an explicit falsifiable proposition is stated
TOKEN_VAZIO is an auditable state, not a positive result
cross-domain dedup requires normalized proposition plus assumptions and provenance

MATH_NOVELTY_CANDIDATE.description: Mathematical construction or proposition whose novelty/equivalence is under study.

MATH_OPEN_PROPOSITION.description: Mathematical proposition with a proof obligation or counterexample search outstanding. Not automatically a novelty candidate.

EMPIRICAL_HYPOTHESIS.description: Falsifiable proposition about measured physical/biological/observational data.

COMPUTATIONAL_HYPOTHESIS.description: Proposition about algorithm/runtime/system behavior requiring executable tests and environment-scoped evidence.

STATISTICAL_MODEL_HYPOTHESIS.description: Model-comparison or parameter proposition requiring declared likelihood, priors, datasets and uncertainty.

METHODOLOGICAL_HYPOTHESIS.description: Proposition that a method improves coverage, reliability, inference or error control; requires benchmark/null comparison.

INTERPRETIVE_SYMBOLIC.description: Symbolic, spiritual or philosophical interpretation. Preserved semantically but excluded from empirical-hypothesis totals unless separately formalized as falsifiable.
